Univariate and multivariate normalities were examined by  the values of skewness (Sk) and Kurtosis (Ku). section_summary.evidence_source:
"Preliminary data analyses
Univariate and multivariate normalities were examined by  the values of skewness (Sk) and Kurtosis (Ku). The skewness values ranged from −0.14 to 0.96 (in the FSCRS_reassure and BMI, respectively), while the values of Kurtosis  ranged from −0.22 to 1.56 (in EDE-Q and BMI, respectively). According to Kline [35], these results revealed that  there was no severe violation of the normal distribution of  the data (z-scores: SK<|3| and Ku<|8–10|)."
